description: Machine-checkable half of the canonical format owned by .agents/skills/find-subjects/references/report-format.md. roots.description: Approved root labels, exactly as recorded in workspace/roots.yml. Labels are user-authored strings, never filesystem paths - the no-raw-path invariant (docs/specs/subject-finder.md, invariant 2) is enforced over this field by validate's subjects check.

workspace_scan.description: The full workspace-scan snapshot (lib/workspace-scan.ts) this note was written from, embedded verbatim - the trace-your-facts validate check searches this object for every structural claim the body makes, exactly as insights notes embed metrics_snapshot.
